description:
## Problem
BenchBox needs a single, owner-approved architectural decision record capturing the data-generation boundary, empirical Phase 0 baselines, per-benchmark budgets, provenance/versioning contract, and cutover gates before Phase 1 or Phase 2 implementation starts.

## Change
- Author docs/internal/adr/adr-benchbox-datagen.md and register it in quality/docs-ownership.json as core-only.
- Explicitly document:
  1. Extension of docs/internal/adr/adr-python-core-runtime.md to cover TPC generation via upstream tpcgen-cli wheels (and why: retiring per-platform C build UB risks while keeping qgen/dsqgen/templates in benchbox).
  2. Strict file/stats boundary tuple, Python DataGenerationManifest as sole _datagen_manifest.json writer, CLI-only native interface, and optional-extra distribution (benchbox remains py3-none-any; native generator is never a required dependency).
  3. Exact default-behavior rule when native-datagen extra is absent so Phase 3 Tier 1 default cutover is consistent with optional-extra packaging and fail-loud explicit --datagen-backend native (distinct from in-tree vectorized Python defaults, which need no extra).
  4. Per-benchmark generator versioning policy (never bumping global DATA_GENERATION_VERSION), folder identity rules ([RUN-DATA-001]), and Parquet layout identity (streaming converter stays default during parallel buildout; direct tpcgen-cli Parquet is opt-in and tracked in data_generation_hash; published-run Parquet default switch deferred to Phase 3).
  5. SSB inclusion policy: versioned per-benchmark RNG and SSB_EXPECTED_ROW_COUNTS migration gated after crr-c2-row-count-references-tpc-and-ssb, pvm-p1-run-ssb-clickbench, and pvm-p2-publish-ssb-clickbench close.
  6. Windows arm64 policy: keep bundled C binaries during parallel buildout and defer keep-vs-drop until Phase 3 retirement after validation.
  7. Concrete per-benchmark wall-time and peak-RSS budgets derived from Phase 0, Gates A–D, and the objective Phase 2 trigger for creating BenchBox-dev/benchbox-datagen.

## Decision gates
- Hard stop: owner must review and approve docs/internal/adr/adr-benchbox-datagen.md before any Phase 1 or Phase 2 implementation PR starts.
- If the Phase 0 tpcgen-cli spike reveals blocking TPC-DS parity gaps, record the exact scope narrowing (e.g., tpch first, tpcds gated on upstream fix) in the ADR rather than proceeding silently.

## Guardrails
- Follow [DURABLE-ARTIFACTS-001]: write for a reader who never saw the session (no phase/wave/work-item labels or unsourced numbers).
- Follow AGENTS.md worktree and PR closeout rules (linked worktree, make pr-preflight, review, merge).
